Definition: from G1 (as a negative particle) and G514; unfit:--unworthy.
BiblicalUsage: Paul asks the Corinthians if they are unworthy to judge the smallest matters, when the saints will judge the world. The word is a rebuke: men fit for the greatest judgment were acting as if they could not settle a small dispute.
TheologicalSignificance: A single rebuke about fitness to judge holds no doctrine of its own; its point is Paul's, that Christians who will judge the world should be able to settle their own quarrels.
